title: Curate source-verified KG chemical aliases and preserve reviewed export boundaries
body:
The fresh KG-Microbe MediaDive output retained `mediadive.ingredient:1315` (`Na acetate x 3 H2O`) even though MIM already had the correct sodium acetate trihydrate owner. This PR adds that exact source alias after MediaDive/ChEBI/PubChem verification, synchronizes the maintained surfaces, and prepares a separate reviewed export candidate. It adds no chemical owner.

The source audit retains all 549 candidates: 415 MediaDive, all 10 MicrobeDecoder compounds (including eight below the old threshold), 82 metatraits and 42 metatraits_gtdb. The saved 201-row MediaDive queue was stale; native regeneration produced 410 rows, and the ledger also preserves four lookup recoveries and the blank source ID. Raw names and source IDs remain intact. MediaDive's constant occurrence value is not reported as recipe frequency.

Changes:

- #1149: one alias on `Sodium_Acetate_Trihydrate`, guarded YAML/canonical publication, receipt 27 and a fresh review of the entire six-token mapping payload. Canonical SSSOM stays at 3,014 rows; only position 2556 changes, plus matching header dates. The full native 3,007-row diagnostic is retained rather than applying its unrelated membership/registry differences.
- #1151: notes/history correction for 3-methylacetate's actual raw minor-product provenance. It stays REJECTED and unmapped; no replacement identity is guessed.
- Native unified rebuild: 13 traced cells across eight rows, all belonging to the same sodium acetate owner; 4,170 rows retain their membership/order. TSV SHA256 `c12f09602dbb4be511c6e813b046fe5965a42134a124a2b3678deb3880591b70`; provenance `7175c41748e60418b6e57a984eb8450aa20ed64b1015286a52aff4ec1c0256f4`.
- #1150/#1152: preserve existing owned-name history through typed refreshes and exclude historical nested backups from the current record inventory while retaining ignored direct records.
- #1153/#1154/#1155: regression-tested target alias, late manifest/candidate and output-parent protections. #1156 corrects release-guide predicate scope without changing gates.

[Report and evidence](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99/reports/kgm_unmapped_chemicals_20261107/README.md) include the source pack, raw/helper provenance, immutable before/after ledgers, native generation, scientific decisions and cell-level unified trace. The comparison has 547 identical candidate entries; sodium 1315 gains its lexical owner hit, and 3-methylacetate changes only the rejected owner's hash. Current/consumed reviewed counts remain 1,739 SUPPORTED and 1,275 WITHHOLD. The 1,739 supported rows include two reviewed broad mappings; withheld bytes are unchanged. Native semantic regeneration withdraws one inherited sodium acetate BUFFER-role approval to OPEN because its owner bytes changed. That role remains under #718; all other nonmapping dispositions are unchanged and the full semantic graph still has unresolved claims. All diagnostic flags overlap and are not summed into a coverage claim.

Candidate reviewed export: `reports/kgm_unmapped_chemicals_20261107/candidate-reviewed-sssom/`. Manifest SHA256 `86cc8cec342e5aa28373abcd59c90e428d3fcfedeef646234a323bb31142bc67`; canonical source SHA256 `097b612c4cce6144a426b64757ea76d447c1d12efcee540dfaac0b6ce163c221`; supported TSV SHA256 `204c7909ecad9762704d950693210a4e25b53fdac2fdb2e8e6689270889d64cd`. The frozen source manifest is `e2f4252a44aabaffaad7d3d3ca27ac0fb96e50b58939747e095e2ca1b9e3b48e` and binds the exact KG-consumed 0dac2784 generation.

All 10 MicrobeDecoder IDs retain 225 exact source-scoped material holds, including both distinct sugar nodes. The five additional MediaDive decisions remain unresolved in #1157: Tris alias scope, pantothenate stereochemistry, nitrilotriacetate monohydrate, silicate pentahydrate/stock and contradictory maltose hydration. This PR does not close #1157 or release those holds.

Verification: native `just qc`, reviewed SSSOM/schema replay, supported KGX and companion exports, unified freshness, Ruff/Black/Mypy, and the full local suite passed. Full pytest: **4,898 passed, 525 skipped, 31 warnings, zero failures**; package coverage 79% against the unchanged 35% floor. All seven new test files executed 183 passing cases with zero skips. Existing optional/data-dependent skips are qualified in the retained evidence.

The [final independent native review](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99/reviews/structured/20261108T033443Z-kgm-unmapped-final-independent-review/review.md) covers 82 targets/432 exact inputs, resolves all five prior finding lineages and finds no new defect in scope: **pass with limitations**. Its science is limited to the sodium acetate mapping/six tokens and rejected 3-methylacetate source provenance; it does not grant corpus, role or downstream release approval. The actual durable 0dac overlay and separate cd76 committed-head audit preserve truthful provenance. The ordinary successor changes only report/review/validation evidence; exact final-head attestation is recorded separately.

Final evidence head: `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. Independent final-head attestation: **no new findings**, with the exact report-only successor verified. Final-head CI: **16/16 SUCCESS**, verified at the exact final head on 2026-11-08 UTC; the PR is ready for review. No merge authorization is requested.

Downstream adoption requires a separately reviewed coherent supported/withheld/disposition/manifest generation plus the unified TSV/provenance pair and KG-Microbe admission checks. No active KG input was replaced, no KG rebuild was started, and no merge is requested. No paid provider credits or mentions.

References: #1149, #1150, #1151, #1152, #1153, #1154, #1155, #1156. Follow-up remains #1157.
